name: Fleming County, KY
findings: Fleming County has 44 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fleming County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
